title: Aetheris
description: A cozy Vanilla+ experience for Minecraft 1.21.11 — familiar survival, thoughtfully expanded.
body:
# ✦ Aetheris

**Aetheris** is a Vanilla+ Minecraft server built for players who love the 
classic survival experience — just with a little more to discover.

No overwhelming overhauls. No steep learning curves. Just the Minecraft you 
know and love, quietly enriched with carefully chosen additions that feel 
right at home.

## What to expect

- A relaxed, friendly atmosphere where you play at your own pace
- Vanilla-faithful additions that blend seamlessly into the base game
- A welcoming community for both new and veteran players
- Stable 1.21.11 gameplay with performance and quality-of-life in mind

## Why Aetheris?

The name comes from *aether* — the ancient concept of a fifth element, 
something beyond the ordinary. That's the idea here: familiar Minecraft, 
elevated just enough to feel like something more.

Whether you're building your dream base, exploring the world, or just 
hanging out — **Aetheris is a place to settle in.**

## How to join

Aetheris is a whitelisted server — here's how to get in:

1. **[Submit an application](https://playaetheris.pro/applications)** — fill out a short form on our website
2. **Wait for a decision** — you'll get a notification in our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/Kchkp9t7Yf) once your application is reviewed
3. **Get whitelisted automatically** — if accepted, you're added to the whitelist right away
4. **Link your Discord in-game** — when you first join, you'll be prompted to connect your Discord account

---

> 📋 **[Apply now →](https://playaetheris.pro/applications)**

> 💬 **[Join our Discord →](https://discord.gg/Kchkp9t7Yf)**

---

*Join us and make it your own.*
